summary: Completed READ-ONLY frontend audit of reference URL with responsive, integration, accessibility, SEO, performance, and simulated network-error checks.

ui_bugs.issue: H1 renders blank because /api/site-content hero_title_pre and hero_title_gold are whitespace strings and CMS injection does not trim.
Conflicting FAQ handlers cause inconsistent open styling/state (.open removed while body height expands).
Hamburger is non-semantic div and not keyboard-tab reachable; hidden off-canvas links are tabbable.
Focus trap and focus restoration missing; Enter key does not submit form path.

integration_issues.issue: On POST /api/leads failure, code still shows thank-you, writes enquiry PII to localStorage, and redirects to /siddha-mala/thankyou.html.

issues: Blank headline leaves visible whitespace in primary fold.
Secondary CTA text has low contrast in current hero state.
Reference page is modal-only for form; inline full consultation form is absent.

action_items: Trim/sanitize CMS hero text values before rendering to avoid blank H1.
Remove fake-success catch path: do not show thank-you or redirect on failed /api/leads; remove localStorage PII fallback.
Unify FAQ logic (single handler), add aria-expanded updates and correct state class behavior.
Fix modal accessibility: trap focus, restore opener focus, and support Enter submit.
Fix mobile nav semantics: convert hamburger to button and prevent hidden menu links from tab order.
Add canonical, OpenGraph metadata, and JSON-LD structured data.
Resolve content consistency: 27+1 vs approx 28 wording and unsupported claim/testimonial language.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate event binding in FAQ (addEventListener + onclick overwrite) introduces contradictory state updates.
Error path stores sensitive lead payload in localStorage and then shows success UX — high-risk anti-pattern.
Hardcoded large-number counter final value ('5,00,000') for any target >=100000 reduces data integrity.
Anchor placeholders ('#') remain in production content for legal links and fallback slide link.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This was a reference-only audit on external URL. Simulated 503 interception for /api/leads confirmed false-success redirect and localStorage fallback. Brochure PDF valid (%PDF, 9.22MB). 7 expert cards and 10 FAQ items exist; FAQ state logic conflicted due duplicate handlers. Landing H1 blank from whitespace CMS fields.
rca of the issue: Primary RCA chain: CMS returns whitespace hero fields -> h1 replaced by empty spans -> hero fold appears blank. Secondary RCA: lead submit catch path intentionally calls showThanks + redirect and localStorage setItem; users see success despite network failure. FAQ RCA: initial single-open accordion logic is later overridden by a second onclick binder in CMS merge block, causing class/state mismatch.
